categories_thin: Financial and wealth advisers: still the thinnest group. Most North Brunswick offices turned out to be branches or branded agencies of national firms (Citizens Wealth, Raymond James, LPL/Prudential-affiliated offices, Edward Jones), so only Agile Wealth Management, Brunswick Financial Group, Garback Financial and KNS Financial survived. Small fee-only RIAs registered at township addresses probably still exist but do not surface in map or directory searches.

Title agencies: two entries now (Providence Abstract, PC Abstract Group). The NJ DOBI title-company licensee list is published as PDFs and the title-search entity registry is one long page; the latter was only seen through search results, so the count is likely incomplete.

Architecture: only MDM Architecture. DNA Architects, previously listed, is at 192 Riva Ave in Milltown per its own contact page and was removed from this zone. AIA New Jersey's find-an-architect tool is form-based and could not be queried.
Appraisers: two entries. NJ licensed-appraiser lookups are one-name-at-a-time, so a township-wide census was not possible.

Commercial third-party property management: Executive Property Management's own site now lists a commercial line, but no firm headquartered in the township does commercial management only. The managers of the large local complexes (Levin Management, Sheldon Gross, Hilton Realty) are based outside the township and were not listed.
caveats: Revision: every entry the verifier flagged was either corrected or removed. Removed as out-of-town or unverifiable: Pavese McCormick Agency (Monmouth Junction), Knoville (New Brunswick), Oliver Youssef CPA (Milltown), Mazraani & Liguori (its own contact page now shows only East Brunswick), BLBAKSH EA PC (705 Nassau Street is Princeton), DNA Architects (192 Riva Ave is Milltown per dnaarch.com).

Revision: removed as excluded brand franchises - CMIT Solutions of North Brunswick, TeamLogic IT, Real Property Management All-Star, Century 21 Burke Realty, Century 21 Gloria Zastko Realty. Also removed as excluded or unsupported: JT Financial Services LLC (shares a storefront with a Jackson Hewitt tax office), the unnamed Cetera office at 622 Georges Road, Brunswick Properties (LinkedIn only, no address), SEO Consulting (generic lead-generation site).

Added during revision after opening a source: Cloud Guardian LLC, Law Office of Gregory Jaeger, MKA Staffing LLC, Brunswick Financial Group LLC, Stone Ridge Engineering, Amertech Engineering, C. Henry Companies, DannLaw's North Brunswick office, Kenneth R. Russell, PC Abstract Group, Garback Financial, KNS Financial, Aita Consulting Service, Polyolefins Consulting, Cray Marketing, WebTheory Media.

Fan-out adjustment: the Don Dutton Agency at 780 Livingston Avenue has been removed. Its own homepage advertises 'Proud to be a Progressive agent for 19 years' with Progressive and GEICO Commercial Auto branding, and a mapping listing files it as a Farmers agency, so it is a brand-tied agency rather than an independent one. The (732) 249-6346 number and 780 Livingston Avenue address in the earlier draft were accurate for that agency.

Franchise handling changed from the earlier draft: independently owned offices flying a national brand are now excluded rather than flagged, per the zone rules. If the owner wants independently owned franchise offices included, Century 21 Burke Realty, Real Property Management All-Star (637 Georges Road, Suite 1B), CMIT Solutions (2227 US Highway 1) and TeamLogic IT (1572 US Highway 130) are the ones to revisit.

Many entries rest on a single blocked directory (Yellow Pages, find-open, cylex, localsolution, promatcher, showmelocal, Angi). Those pages returned 403 to direct fetches, so their content was reached only through search-engine summaries. Every such entry is marked 'one directory only' and its address and phone need phone confirmation before outreach - a known quality limit, not a verified fact set.

Unresolved detail conflicts carried forward and re-noted rather than silently fixed: Prime Tax (two or three different phone numbers), Jai Tax (IRS 82 Fleet Street vs a directory's 1463 Finnegan Lane), Shuja Financial (two phone numbers), Mid County Agency (single cross-listing page), Paragon Staffing (Carolier Lane vs Ridgewood Avenue), Staffing Alternatives (toll-free vs a local number), Pisciotta & Menasha (513 Georges Road vs 1572 US Highway 130), Kiran CPA (two numbers).
Google Maps was used only as a spot check in the earlier session and would not paginate, so map coverage here is not a census. No map results are cited in this revision.
OpenStreetMap / Overpass API was unreachable in the earlier session (502 from overpass-api.de), so no OSM cross-check was possible in this zone.
North Brunswick's land area lies entirely within about five miles of central Milltown, so every entry passes the 10-mile radius test.
data_gaps: No township-issued business licence list or business registry was located on northbrunswicknj.gov; the site's documents are procurement awards (architect, appraiser, financial adviser, IT support), not a business directory.
BBB North Brunswick category pages (information technology, web design, property management, employment agencies) are Cloudflare-blocked, so the accredited-business rosters there were not read.

Avvo, Justia and Super Lawyers attorney indexes were reached only through search summaries, not paged directly, so the count of solo attorneys in the township is understated. The Law Office of Joanna J. Tyrpa (listed at 825 Georges Road by directories) surfaced this way but her firm's own site gives a Princeton office, so she was not listed.
The NJ DOBI title-company licensee list is published as PDF (nj.gov/dobi/titlecos260502.pdf) and was not parsed; only the title-search entity registry surfaced PC Abstract Group.

Several entries have a phone or an address but not both: BetaBulls, CAS AMIE, Mundra Appraisals, Medina Tech Solutions, Salem Engineering, Garback Financial, Cyber Resource Group, Home Access Realty, Dell Principle Brokerage, Trinity Realty. A website visit or phone call is needed to place them.

South Brunswick / Monmouth Junction, Milltown, New Brunswick and East Brunswick businesses that turned up in North Brunswick searches (Pavese McCormick, Knoville, Oliver Youssef, Mazraani & Liguori, DNA Architects) belong to other zones and are not counted here.
